points.heading: A helper plus a participle
points.body:
Central idea: Compound tenses have a helper form of haber and a participle.

Explore: He cantado connects a finished action to now. Había cantado puts it before another past moment. The participle stays cantado.

Practice: Write he comido, habías comido, habremos comido, and habría comido. Mark the helper in each.

Common mistake: Do not change comido to comidos when the subject changes.

lesson.summary: This lesson teaches practice two-word times. Understand the central idea first, then explore it, practice it, and check a common mistake.
